preconditions.description: The number of words n is between 1 and 8 inclusive.
The chainword length m is between 1 and 10^9 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= len(w) <= 5 and w.islower() and w.isalpha() for w in words)
preconditions.description: Each word in the dictionary is a non-empty string of 1 to 5 lowercase Latin letters.
All words in the dictionary are pairwise distinct.

postconditions.description: The output is a single integer representing the count modulo 998244353.

postconditions.expression: int(stdout.strip()) == (sum(1 for s in all_strings(m) if is_valid_chainword(s, words)) % 998244353)
postconditions.description: The output equals the total number of valid chainword instances (string, top hint, bottom hint) modulo 998244353, where a valid instance requires the string to be decomposable into dictionary words for both the top and bottom hints.
